text:
maya-support: FYI escalating a customer request — EU regulator wants proof of erasure and residency export. Customer reports our erasure API returning 403 sometimes and 5xx on retries. attaching initial details below. @security-lena @sre-anna @eng-jordan :wave

oliver-cust: we need a signed audit extract showing the record was deleted and that the data never left eu-west-1. also saw `403` on `/v1/erasure` around 08:12 UTC and then a `502` on retry. timeline attached. regulator asked for KMS key id used for deletion.

maya-support: customer also mentioned billing/tokens oddity — they see two different project tokens active, one shows as disabled in console but still used by our api gateway. could be cause of auth routing to a fallback that doesn't accept erasure scope.

sre-anna: can you paste the raw request/response? need request id and edge node.

maya-support: pasted logs from customer below (sanitized):
```
REQUEST /v1/erasure
host: api.redwood.ai
authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED
x-request-id: req_0a9f3c
region: eu-west-1
body: {"user_id":"u-9283","scope":"erasure"}
---
RESP 403
{"error":"forbidden","message":"token missing: data:erase"}
timestamp: 2026-11-02T08:12:11Z
---
RESP 502
{"error":"backend_unavailable"}
edge: edge-eu-7
trace: trace-77f3"
```

eng-jordan: quick hypothesis: two things — 1) token scope mismatch on their rotated token (console shows disabled but gateway cached policy), 2) routing fallback landed on a legacy host that doesn't have the erasure handler deployed so it 502s. I can repro locally if SRE can forward a request dump.

sre-anna: replayed their request from our replay queue against edge-eu-7 and reproduced `502` and `403` when using the older token. I collected host logs:
```
edge-eu-7 | 2026-11-02T08:12:11Z | auth: token policy lookup -> cached(policy_v1)
edge-eu-7 | 2026-11-02T08:12:11Z | handler /v1/erasure -> not found -> proxy to backend -> 502
backend-erase-01 | 2026-11-02T08:12:12Z | auth: token missing scope data:erase -> 403
```

security-lena: for the regulator export: we can provide a signed audit log export for the user_id and the erasure operation. we need to confirm which KMS key encrypted the export (customer asked for key id). note: our on-disk retention record shows key `projects/eu/redwood/keysets/erasure-2025` used for sealing the audit export. we should include KMS key thumbprint and HSM attestation if they ask.

maya-support: customer asked if data ever left eu-west-1 — SRE replay shows no egress to other regions. can we produce a residency statement plus netflow snippet?

sre-anna: yes — generated network flow summary for the timeframe (attached). no cross-region egress observed. I'll include the edge host list and timestamps.

eng-jordan: for root cause fix: schedule a rolling deploy to ensure the erasure handler is present on all edge fleets, and invalidate auth cache on gateway when token state changes. I can prepare a patch. minimal repro steps for QA:
1) rotate token via console (create token -> disable -> revoke)
2) call `/v1/erasure` with old token -> expect 403
3) call with new token routed to a legacy edge -> expect 502

Example repro curl we used:
```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/erasure" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-OLDTOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user_id":"u-9283"}'
```

security-lena: for the audit export package we will provide:
- signed CSV of actions (sha256)
- KMS key identifier + sig (key id: `erasure-2025`, thumbprint `ab12cd34`)
- HSM attestation certificate (if requested)
- residency statement (edges + flow summary)

oliver-cust: thanks. regulator also wants proof of deletion (object-level). can you include a sample soft-delete -> purge timeline with event IDs so they can reconcile?

maya-support: will assemble a single bundle: signed log export, key metadata, flow summary, and a deletion timeline (event ids). planning to deliver via our secure file transfer (SFT) endpoint and provide a signed manifest. ETA ~ end of day. @audit-bot: trigger retention-export job for `u-9283` window 2026-11-02 07:00-09:00 UTC.

audit-bot: retention-export queued -> job_id: job_55e3f. estimated completion 15m. :white_check_mark:

sre-anna: follow-up action items:
- invalidate auth cache for token state changes (SRE + Eng)
- patch edge fleet to ensure erasure handler is present (Eng)
- produce signed export bundle and provide KMS/HSM artifacts (Security + Support)

eng-jordan: I'll open a follow-up PR and assign to oncall for the hotfix.

maya-support: thanks all — I'll keep customer updated and attach the bundle when job completes. closing the regulator escalation once they confirm receipt. :thumbsup:
